title: The Underworld Took Attendance at 3 A.M. — and Marked the Boss Present
description:
A factory boss rewrites a worker's time of death to dodge a curse and cash in. He even signs the form "like family".
The underworld reads paperwork very carefully. Told by the than trung, the underworld's most punctual clerk.

A fictional story inspired by Vietnamese folklore about the than trung — the underworld clerk who comes back when someone dies at a cursed hour. Characters and events are fictional. Voices and images were made with AI.

New episodes every few days. Subscribe @ThePettyGhost — a petty little house ghost tells you what the living get up to.
